description: This Java class, ColorManager, assigns colors to activities and tasks within an Android application, managing mappings between activity components or task IDs and color resources.

classes.name: ColorManager
classes.description: Manages assignment of color resources to activities and tasks within the application, ensuring consistent and unique coloring.

methods.name: getColorForActivity
methods.description: Returns the assigned color for a specific activity, creating a new assignment if none exists.

methods.name: getColorForTask
methods.description: Returns the assigned color for a specific task ID, creating a new assignment if none exists.

methods.name: nextTaskColor
methods.description: Provides the next color in the sequence for tasks, cycling through the color array.

methods.name: nextActivityColor
methods.description: Provides the next color in the sequence for activities, cycling through the color array.
